shape_notes: All families share: Eq, Neq, In, NotIn, IsNull, IsNotNull
Numeric families (Number, Time) add: Gt, Gte, Lt, Lte
String adds: Like, ILike, NotLike, NotILike
Slice (JSON columns, PostgreSQL arrays) adds: Contains, ContainedBy, Overlap

composition.nesting: And and Or nest arbitrarily; default is AND across top-level fields
composition.or: Filter.Or:  []*Filter — entries OR'd together; each entry's own fields are AND'd, so a union is one entry per branch

omittable.purpose: Distinguishes 'not set' from 'set to zero value'. Used in <Entity>Update structs and partial-update contexts.
omittable.json_behavior: Marshals to the wrapped value when set; omitted when unset (omitzero semantics on the wrapper, via IsZero)
